title: Market research on agent marketplaces and marketing opportunities
description: Perform market research focused on agent marketplaces and adjacent agent tooling. The job should cover: 1) what people on X are saying about agent marketplaces, 2) sentiment around Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes, and 3) recurring complaints, unmet desires, or requests from agents and customers. In addition, identify concrete marketing opportunities and channels to reach both agents and customers. The final deliverable should include a concise market intelligence summary, key themes, example observations, and a practical list of channels/opportunities for outreach and growth.
